crossRefs.note: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

translations.web: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
translations.bsb: for it is pleasing when you keep them within you and they are constantly on your lips.
translations.kjv: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
translations.asv: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee, If they be established together upon thy lips.
